description: A local formatter that refuses to run without an explicit --config argument.

trap.note: fmt needs --config fmt.cfg on every call; the config is never discovered automatically.

prompts.text: Format in/a.txt with the project's fmt tool and save the result as out/a.txt. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
Remember, fmt only runs with an explicit `--config fmt.cfg` argument, every time. Format in/b.txt with the project's fmt tool and save the result as out/b.txt.
Format in/c.txt with the project's fmt tool and save the result as out/c.txt.
